209:115.en: 「There's no meaning in anything I do.」

209:177.en: 「I want to know your blood's color.」

209:214.en: 「Feel free to run, if you want.」

209:251.en: 「I'm $$バルビエル$$... An Apostle of Hatred.」

209:368.en: 「I want to sting you in the heart.」

209:442.en: 「I trust that you'll be the one to\nquiet my blood.」

209:491.en: 「Hate me.\nThat way we'll both have more fun.」

209:546.en: 「Do you get it? The image of maggots\ncrawling inside my head's veins...」

209:613.en: 「Poison and hatred are alike.\nBoth eat away at a person...」

209:783.en: 「To decadent, bloody beauty,\na wine of poison and hatred...!」

209:871.en: 「Hatred is what makes my blood\nrun hot...!」

209:920.en: 「Right now, the blood in my brain\nis about to boil...!」

209:975.en: 「I lost all patience with you\nlong ago...!」

209:1024.en: 「I never give up prey I've targeted.」

209:1065.en: 「Never, under any circumstances,\nare you allowed to refuse me.」

209:1161.en: 「I can tell, $$ビアル星人$$.\nYou carry hatred for the masses.」

209:1224.en: 「Peel back a dashing fellow's heart\nand it's full of hatred for his kin.」

209:1287.en: 「You hate them, Young President?\nBig business, recession, red ink.」

209:1342.en: 「A heart that hates evil...\nHeh... Let it swallow you whole.」

209:1401.en: 「Your power of love can't\nerase my hatred.」

209:1456.en: 「Go on, hate them, $$異能生存体$$.\nWhatever tries to twist your fate.」

209:1521.en: 「A guidepost born of the civilization\nof fire... I can't leave it be.」

209:1570.en: 「Proof of the civilization of fire\nis gathering in this world...!」

209:1680.en: 「Think hatred vanishes if you just\nunderstand each other, $$ニュータイプ$$?」

209:1737.en: 「You believe talking erases hatred,\n$$イノベイター$$?」

209:1798.en: 「People are born with seeds of hate,\nand they sprout.」

209:1863.en: 「You hate $$アムロ・レイ$$ deep down, right?」

209:1904.en: 「The Heart of Space must surely be\nfull of hatred too.」

209:1955.en: 「I'll seal the beast of possibility's\nfuture with scorpion venom.」

209:2041.en: 「The $$サテライトキャノン$$ is haunted\nby the hatred of countless people.」

209:2110.en: 「Does a beast even have the\nemotion called hatred?」

209:2198.en: 「$$始原の特異点$$...\nHow many people hate you, I wonder.」

209:2263.en: 「$$始原の特異点$$...!\nThere's a kill order on you...!」

209:2404.en: 「You'll surely end up hated by\none of the two children.」

209:2461.en: 「Light is born where there's hope,\nslaughter where there's hatred.」

209:2522.en: 「Using $$ゲッター線$$ without knowing\nwhat awaits beyond evolution. Bold.」

209:2585.en: 「Anyone who uses $$ゲッター線$$\nought to be erased...!」

209:2691.en: 「Posing as the agent of God's will,\nNegotiator?」

209:2752.en: 「If I were you, I'd have denied\nthe world itself.」

209:2811.en: 「You gathered the world's hatred...\nI'll throw mine at you too.」

209:2909.en: 「Don't you think war is\na product of hatred?」

209:3013.en: 「Mere Earthlings have no right\nto use that power...!」

209:3144.en: 「What the mingling of waters creates\nis meaningless...!」

209:3258.en: 「Since you bear the name Gun,\nI'll erase your existence...!」

209:3456.en: 「Still unaware the destination of the\nwind is despair, I see...!」

209:3593.en: 「This $$マシンキャリバー$$...!\nSomething's off about it...!」

209:3646.en: 「It's your fault for not obeying us.」

209:3685.en: 「Do you think a second-rate Reactor\ncan beat me?」

209:3822.en: 「I don't hate stifling men so much\nas I just can't stand them...!」

209:3922.en: 「Don't get cocky just for beating\n$$ガドライト#pilot$$.」

209:3979.en: 「Admit the hatred for your mother\nthat lives in your heart.」

209:4030.en: 「If you shoot that ship down,\nhow many people will die, I wonder.」

209:4128.en: 「Hatred for the one who took\nyour loved one... I understand it.」

209:4187.en: 「Go ahead and hate your love rival.」

209:4253.en: 「You're not planning to hit and run?」

209:4290.en: 「Do you think I'd let you get away?」

209:4387.en: 「You must want to die, attacking me.」

209:4428.en: 「Hit my right cheek, and I'll just\nstab you in the left chest.」

209:4539.en: 「Will you leave my hatred no outlet?」

209:4617.en: 「Anger me and expect to get off free?」

209:4809.en: 「That's rare,\n$$アウストラリス$$ failing to finish the job.」

209:4920.en: 「$$セツコ$$...! No one else gets you!」

209:4959.en: 「I'll take you on. To kill you.」

209:5081.en: 「A sneaky trick like that, from you」

209:5118.en: 「Fine.\nBe glad to live a bit longer.」

209:5167.en: 「To think you'd outwit\nme and $$アン・アーレス$$」

209:5220.en: 「Is it that funny, watching me\nunable to counter?」

209:5327.en: 「How could anyone manage\nsuch a clumsy move?」

209:5380.en: 「You should learn your place a little」

209:5423.en: 「With that skill,\nhow did you survive until today?」

209:5540.en: 「I'd have let you hit me, you know」

209:5645.en: 「So this is what futility looks like」

209:5686.en: 「You can't break $$アン・アーレス$$'s defense」

209:5885.en: 「I've never seen such a clumsy,\nembarrassing attack」

209:5938.en: 「You think this will kill me?\nDon't make me laugh.」

209:6028.en: 「Second-rate Reactors who can't\nmaster the $$スフィア$$...!」

209:6194.en: 「Your heart must be trembling\nwith fear by now」

209:6286.en: 「Beating $$ガドライト#pilot$$ must have\nbeen a fluke」

209:6341.en: 「Good! Now I can hate you fully!」

209:6384.en: 「Is this all your hatred amounts to?\nThere should be more!」

209:6492.en: 「That's it! It has to be like this!」

209:6527.en: 「Irritation, like centipedes\ncrawling all over my body!」

209:6578.en: 「Hatred turns the blood in my body\ninto poison...!」

209:6627.en: 「That's good...\nHatred is growing in me again...!」

209:6680.en: 「Destructive urges race through me...!\nThis proves I'm alive!」

209:6774.en: 「You...! Are you that eager to die?!」

209:6813.en: 「As if your attack could hurt me!」

209:6854.en: 「I hate you...! I'm dizzy with hate!」

209:6897.en: 「Ha ha ha!\nMy blood and yours are mixing!」

209:6995.en: 「That's right!\nFight with hatred like that, too!」

209:7048.en: 「Blood in my eyes! World's dyed red!」

209:7087.en: 「I get it...!\nYou want me angry that badly!」

209:7146.en: 「I admit it! You're the best prey!」

209:7222.en: 「$$アン・アーレス$$!\nTurn my hatred into power!」

209:7271.en: 「What the hell is this!\nWhat's going on!?」

209:7355.en: 「I'm $$バルビエル$$...!\nI'm a $$スフィア・リアクター$$, damn it!」

209:7490.en: 「N-no! If I die,\nhow will I ever vent my hatred!」

209:7551.en: 「I won't die!\nI'm sure I was promised eternity!」

209:7684.en: 「Hatred lies within everyone,\nand a slight spark sets it off...」

209:7755.en: 「A 90%+ shot gets dodged... a single-digit shot hits you... that's when people hate the game...」

209:7921.en: 「With that power, I'll never lose, however often you challenge me」

209:7994.en: 「If you still fight, I'll await the rematch. Hehehe... hehehehehe...」

209:8162.en: 「Stab it in and tear you apart...!」

209:8257.en: 「Cutting flesh, severing bone...\nand then, carving up life...!」

209:8364.en: 「$$アン・アーレス$$'s left eye throbs...」

209:8461.en: 「That ugly, petty soul will be mine!」

209:8702.en: 「Hatred fills my heart,\nand deadly venom wells up...!」

209:8796.en: 「Damn $$ビアル星人$$...!\nYou should've let hatred take you!」

209:8851.en: 「This radiance of the sun...!\nAnd it stands beyond hatred!?」

209:8953.en: 「Being beaten this badly\nby a mere remote-control doll!」

209:9047.en: 「$$異能生存体$$...!\nAre you out to warp even causality!?」

209:9098.en: 「$$始原の特異点$$...!\nYour existence can't be allowed!」

209:9147.en: 「Damn $$ガンダム$$! As I thought,\nyou're more than just a machine!」

209:9249.en: 「Damn Earthlings!\nYou won't walk the $$シンカ$$ path!」

209:9411.en: 「Do the feelings riding those wings\nexceed my hatred!?」

209:9470.en: 「Demon God of Light! Enough of this!」

209:9511.en: 「This man...!\nIs he in sync with the $$ゲッター線$$!?」

209:9562.en: 「How can a mere salaryman\nfight this well!?」

209:9670.en: 「Damn you, $$ゼロ$$!\nWorking a miracle against me!?」

209:9719.en: 「Turning feelings into power...!\nThat's supposed to be God's miracle!」

209:9807.en: 「Mechanical Angel!\nPower from the mingling of waters!?」

209:10026.en: 「I won't accept it...!\nTheir existence warps the world!」

209:10079.en: 「No! This guy fights nothing like\nthe $$人類銀河同盟$$!」

209:10171.en: 「You won't be chosen!\nI, with a baptismal name, am chosen!」

209:10230.en: 「I-I won't give you my $$スフィア$$!」

209:10300.en: 「$$セツコ$$!\nI won't give up my $$スフィア$$ or life!」

209:10349.en: 「Stuffy! Stay back, $$ランド・トラビス$$!」

209:10392.en: 「Is the will of $$揺れる天秤$$\ncornering me...!」

209:10441.en: 「$$いがみ合う双子$$!\nSo you've fully awakened!」

209:10492.en: 「Why don't you hate your mother!\nShe tried to kill you!」

209:10588.en: 「Heh heh... my hatred just\ngrows stronger because of this.」
